language_rules: Use prepared_not_submitted rather than submitted for registry packets.
Use source-verified rather than implemented-and-tested when Cargo evidence is absent.
Describe PRISMA-S as reporting guidance, not a conduct certification.
Describe extraction output as evidence, not canonical bibliographic truth.
Describe a consumer-contract suite as prepared until both producer and consumer receipts exist.
